english.notes:
Section 36 of the Terrorist Asset-Freezing etc. Act 2010 provides time limit for proceedings for summary offences as follows:-
36(1) In England and Wales an information relating to an offence under section 19(5) or 22 may be tried by a magistrates' court if it is laid:-(a) at any time within three years after the commission of the offence, and (b) within twelve months after the date on which evidence sufficient in the opinion of the prosecutor to justify the proceedings comes to the knowledge of the prosecutor.

Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
Complex - see section 36

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
